data.one_liner: Baidu Map public base plugin for Flutter providing native Android and iOS libraries.
data.what_it_does: The flutter_baidu_mapapi_base plugin offers public Flutter and native libraries (including Android and iOS) that act as a base component for other Baidu Map components and plugins. It provides core functionality such as map display, overlays, coordinate systems, and SDK integrations.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app requiring Baidu Map integration.
You are using other Baidu Map components that depend on this base library.
avoid_when: Your project does not use Baidu Map services.
You require non-Baidu mapping solutions like Google Maps.
strengths: Provides official base and native support for Baidu Maps across Android and iOS.
Frequently updated with native SDK upgrades and new mapping features.
weaknesses: Region-specific to platforms where Baidu Maps is applicable.
Documentation is sparse outside of changelogs and basic setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration and setup for Baidu Map SDKs on Android and iOS.
